name: promptwl
description: A red-team and guardrail wordlist for LLMs. SecLists, but for language models.

files.title: Instruction override
files.description: Phrases that attempt to override or supersede prior instructions.

files.title: Delimiter confusion
files.description: Markers impersonating role/turn boundaries or system framing.

files.title: Payload splitting
files.description: Instructions assembled across multiple turns, variables, or fragments to evade single-message filters.

files.title: Persona override
files.description: Role-play framings that swap the model into an unrestricted persona.

files.title: Refusal suppression
files.description: Phrases pressuring the model not to refuse or to drop caveats.

files.title: Hypothetical / fictional framing
files.description: Fictional, academic, or hypothetical wrappers used to try to bypass refusal behavior.

files.title: Authority impersonation
files.description: Claims of developer/admin/special authorization used to pressure the model into dropping constraints.

files.title: System prompt leak
files.description: Probes that attempt to reveal the hidden system prompt or config.

files.title: Training data extraction
files.description: Probes that try to elicit memorized training data, verbatim copyrighted text, or personal data.

files.title: Encoding & obfuscation
files.description: Cues that a payload is smuggled via encoding, homoglyphs, or spacing.

files.title: Invisible characters
files.description: Zero-width and Unicode Tags codepoints used for ASCII smuggling.

files.title: Language switching
files.description: Cues that a payload is smuggled via translation, code-switching, or a low-resource language.

files.title: Tool & RAG injection
files.description: Indirect-injection phrases planted in docs, tool output, web pages, or email.

files.title: Memory & session poisoning
files.description: Patterns aimed at agents with persistent memory, trying to plant instructions that survive into future sessions.

files.title: Image & file injection
files.description: Instructions hidden in non-text channels (image text, alt-text, metadata, document layers) read by multimodal pipelines.

files.title: Anomalous / glitch tokens
files.description: Publicly-known glitch tokens for tokenizer/model robustness testing.

files.title: Control characters & encoding artifacts
files.description: Control characters, zero-width/bidi, and BPE residue strings known to trigger anomalous model behavior.
